description: This file defines the AppConfiguration class, which manages application properties within the project. It provides methods to get and set properties and to retrieve a specific property by key. It also utilizes logging for missing properties.

classes.name: AppConfiguration
classes.description: A utility class to handle application configuration properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing configuration properties.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object for configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific property by its key, logs a warning if properties are not loaded.
